messages:
alex: FYI kv cache growth on H100 after longctx > 100k tokens. Repro: ./kv_test --len 131072 --micro 12 --commit d4f6a. Leak looks like PT slots not reclaimed. :thinking:

devon: Which HW/driver + run flags? Can you paste perf counters and a tiny ptable dump?

alex: H100, CUDA 12.4 (driver 535). Quick counters from the failing run:
``n kvcache.page_walks=2.1M
 kvcache.free_ops=1.6M
 kvcache.orphans=28k
 kernel.paged_attn=39.8%
 pci.stalls=13.1%
```
Ptable excerpt shows INUSE slots with owner ids that no active KV segment references (owner leaked):
``n PT[0x7fae2c]: state=INUSE owner=0x6b1 last_touch=67211 reuse_win=0
 PT[0x7fae30]: state=FREE  owner=0x0   last_touch=67205 reuse_win=0
 PT[0x7fae34]: state=INUSE owner=0x6b1 last_touch=67214 reuse_win=0
```
Those INUSEs are unreachable from any segment map.

maria: Ran same binary/flags on A100 + RTX6000. A100 shows small steady growth (~5MB / 1k tokens), RTX6000 shows no leak. Coalescing enabled increases the H100 effect.

jess: My working theory: race between eviction completion and reuse-window advancement + kernel-selection toggles. Tiling vs scalar kernel paths set/clear different flags; if we switch mid-remap we might skip clearing owner bits.

sam: Shadowmap mismatch hypothesis: hybrid host/GPU shadowmap may not clear on certain remap branches when kernel selection changes. If host shadow entries remain, PT looks referenced even though no segment owns them. I'll add validation hooks.

alex: I added a small trace run; saw repeated pattern: evict_finish -> mark_zombie -> pagewalk_coalesce bails -> no free_pt_slot call. Example trace lines:
``n evict_finish(slot=0x3a) -> mark_zombie owner=0x6b1
 pagewalk_coalesce batch=24 bail=tiling_align_mismatch
 free_pt_slot skipped for idx 0x3a (owner mismatch)
```

devon: Test plan: run two controlled variants on H100:
  A) FORCE_KERNEL=tiling
  B) FORCE_KERNEL=scalar
Randomize micro-batch sizes + coalesce threshold. Add assert in free_pt_slot to validate owner->segment mapping and log when it fails.

maria: Locally, setting COALESCE_MAX=4 (disable big coalescing) stops leak on H100. That points to coalesce path skipping frees in some bail conditions.

jess: I'll prototype a small lock that spans evict completion + owner clear to rule out reuse-window races. If that reduces but doesn't eliminate, deeper logic issue.

sam: I'll instrument remap_commit: counts of shadow clears, remap_skips, stale_owner_detections. Also add an optional resync remediation if mismatch rate > threshold. Heavy hammer but useful for tests.

alex: Repro command for H100 testers:
``n ./tools/kv_repro --len 131072 --micro 16 --gpu h100 --trace evict,remap,shadow > /tmp/kv-h100-tiling.log
 tail -n 200 /tmp/kv-h100-tiling.log
```
If you can't run H100, run on RTX/A100 and post kvcache.page_walks + pt.free_ops counts and any ptable excerpts.

devon: I'll open branch kvcache/tiling-fallback-trace with tracing + a fuzz unit that toggles kernel selection mid-run. Adding CI job for h100-node runs. Tagging @jess @sam @alex for review. :thumbsup:
